chunks: For We shall certainly turn it to barren dust.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the earth becoming barren dust?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the impermanence of the material world (Dunya) as a testing ground, contrasting it with the eternal abode of the Hereafter. It serves as a reminder that all earthly possessions and life itself are temporary, reinforcing the concept of divine sovereignty over creation's transformation from fertile to barren.
